q: Author of the epic poem 'Gabbalam'.
explanation: Gabbilam (1941), in which a bat carries a Dalit's message to God, is Gurram Jashuva's best-known work – not Sri Sri's, C. Narayana Reddy's or Chalam's.

notes.text: - **Bhava Kavitvam:** romantic, personal emotion, nature, love; poets Basavaraju Apparao, Duvvuri Ramireddy (*Matru Desa Sankeertanam*), Devulapalli Krishna Sastri (Andhra Shelley), Venkata Parvateeswara Kavulu (*Ekanta Seva*).

q: Who described Joshua as a "Madhurakavi"?
explanation: Viswanatha Satyanarayana described Gurram Jashuva as 'Madhurakavi'.
